description: A configurable in-buffer previewer for Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, Typst, YAML, and Asciidoc in Neovim.
author: OXY2DEV
tagline: Render rich markup previews directly inside Neovim buffers.

options.label: Enable Preview
options.description: Enable preview when Markview attaches to a buffer.

options.label: Enable Hybrid Mode
options.description: Enable hybrid mode when Markview attaches to a buffer.

options.label: Map gx
options.description: Map buffer-local normal-mode gx to :Markview open for Markview's tree-sitter-aware link opener.

options.label: Icon Provider
options.description: Choose the icon provider used for code block labels, or disable icons.

options.label: Refresh Debounce
options.description: Delay in milliseconds between preview refreshes.

options.label: Attached Filetypes
options.description: Filetypes where Markview should try to attach.

options.label: Ignored Buftypes
options.description: Buffer types Markview should not attach to.

options.label: Preview Modes
options.description: Vim modes in which rendered previews are shown.

options.label: Hybrid Modes
options.description: Vim modes in which hybrid mode is active. A mode must also be present in preview.modes.

options.label: Linewise Hybrid Mode
options.description: Clear lines around the cursor in hybrid mode instead of clearing syntax nodes.

options.label: Maximum Full Render Lines
options.description: Maximum buffer line count before Markview switches to partial rendering.

options.label: Partial Draw Range
options.description: Lua list containing the number of lines to draw above and below each cursor.

options.label: Hybrid Edit Range
options.description: Number of lines above and below each cursor considered edited in hybrid mode.

options.label: Splitview Window Options
options.description: Lua table passed to nvim_open_win() when opening Markview's splitview.

options.label: Raw Hybrid Previews
options.description: Lua table of per-language inclusion and exclusion rules shown as raw text in hybrid mode.

options.label: Enable Asciidoc
options.description: Enable Asciidoc rendering.

options.label: Enable Inline Asciidoc
options.description: Enable inline Asciidoc rendering.

options.label: Enable Comments
options.description: Enable comment rendering when fancy comment attachment is active.

options.label: Enable HTML
options.description: Enable HTML rendering.

options.label: Enable LaTeX
options.description: Enable LaTeX rendering.

options.label: Enable Markdown
options.description: Enable Markdown block rendering.

options.label: Enable Inline Markdown
options.description: Enable inline Markdown rendering.

options.label: Enable Typst
options.description: Enable Typst rendering.

options.label: Enable YAML
options.description: Enable YAML rendering.

options.label: Render Block Quotes
options.description: Render Markdown block quotes and callouts.

options.label: Wrap Block Quotes
options.description: Support wrapped text inside Markdown block quotes.

options.label: Render Code Blocks
options.description: Render fenced Markdown code blocks.

options.label: Render Headings
options.description: Render Markdown headings.

options.label: Heading Shift Width
options.description: Additional indentation width used for Markdown heading content.

options.label: Org-style Heading Indent
options.description: Indent Markdown sections according to heading depth.

options.label: Wrap Org-style Indent
options.description: Apply org-style heading indentation to wrapped lines.

options.label: Org Indent Character
options.description: Character used for org-style heading indentation.

options.label: Org Indent Width
options.description: Number of indent characters added per heading level.

options.label: Render Horizontal Rules
options.description: Render Markdown horizontal rules.

options.label: Render List Items
options.description: Render Markdown list item markers.

options.label: Wrap List Items
options.description: Support wrapped text inside Markdown list items.

options.label: List Shift Width
options.description: Additional indentation width used for Markdown list item content.

options.label: Render YAML Frontmatter
options.description: Render Markdown metadata blocks delimited by dashes.

options.label: Render Plus Frontmatter
options.description: Render Markdown metadata blocks delimited by plus signs.

options.label: Render Reference Definitions
options.description: Render Markdown link reference definitions.

options.label: Render Tables
options.description: Render Markdown tables.

options.label: Strict Tables
options.description: Require stricter Markdown table structure.

options.label: Table Block Decorator
options.description: Draw the outer block decoration around Markdown tables.

options.label: Use Virtual Table Lines
options.description: Use virtual lines while rendering Markdown table decoration.

options.label: Render Block References
options.description: Render inline Markdown block references.

options.label: Render Checkboxes
options.description: Render Markdown checkbox states.

options.label: Render Email Links
options.description: Render Markdown email autolinks.

options.label: Render Embedded Files
options.description: Render embedded file links.

options.label: Render Entities
options.description: Render HTML entities in inline Markdown.

options.label: Render Emoji Shorthands
options.description: Render emoji shorthand syntax.

options.label: Render Escapes
options.description: Render escaped inline Markdown characters.

options.label: Render Footnotes
options.description: Render Markdown footnotes.

options.label: Render Highlights
options.description: Render inline Markdown highlights.

options.label: Render Hyperlinks
options.description: Render Markdown hyperlinks.

options.label: Render Images
options.description: Render Markdown image links.

options.label: Render Inline Code
options.description: Render Markdown inline code spans.

options.label: Render Internal Links
options.description: Render Obsidian-style internal links.

options.label: Render URI Autolinks
options.description: Render URI autolinks.

options.label: Render Tags
options.description: Render Obsidian-style tags.

options.label: Fancy Comments
options.description: Try to attach to every buffer with an available tree-sitter parser so comments can be rendered.

notices.message: Fancy comments change buffer attachment selection.
notices.details: The default preview condition checks all buffers for a tree-sitter parser when this option is enabled, taking precedence over preview.filetypes and preview.ignore_buftypes.

options.label: Open Text Files in Neovim
options.description: Open detected text files inside Neovim instead of using vim.ui.open().

options.label: File Open Command
options.description: Neovim command used to open text files when experimental.prefer_nvim is enabled.

options.label: List Empty-line Tolerance
options.description: Number of repeated empty lines needed to terminate a list item.

options.label: Link Read Chunk Size
options.description: Bytes read while determining whether a linked file is text.

options.label: YAML Date Formats
options.description: Lua patterns used to recognize date values in YAML.

options.label: YAML Date-time Formats
options.description: Lua patterns used to recognize date-time values in YAML.

options.label: Custom Renderers
options.description: Lua table mapping parsed node types to custom renderer functions.

functions.name: clear
functions.label: Clear Preview
functions.shortDescription: Clear Markview decorations from a buffer.
functions.description: Clear Markview's rendered preview from a buffer.

params.name: buffer
params.description: Buffer to clear; defaults to the current buffer.

functions.name: render
functions.label: Render Preview
functions.shortDescription: Render a buffer with optional state and configuration.
functions.description: Low-level rendering API. It does not configure conceallevel or concealcursor.

params.name: state
params.description: Optional buffer state with enable and hybrid_mode fields.

functions.name: strict_clear
functions.label: Clear Strict Preview
functions.shortDescription: Allow a strictly rendered buffer to be rendered again.
functions.description: Clear a buffer rendered through the strict rendering API and release its render guard.

params.name: buffer
params.description: Buffer to clear; defaults to the current buffer.

functions.name: strict_render
functions.label: Strict Render
functions.description: Recommended high-level API for on-demand rendering in external plugins.

params.name: buffer
params.description: Buffer to render; defaults to the current buffer.

params.name: max_lines
params.description: Skip rendering when the buffer has at least this many lines; defaults to preview.max_buf_lines.

functions.name: parse
functions.label: Parse Buffer
functions.shortDescription: Parse supported markup trees in a buffer.
functions.description: Initialize Markview's parsers and return parsed and language-sorted node tables.
functions.technicalNote: The Lua function returns two tables; the declared table return represents the primary parsed-node result.

params.name: from
params.description: Optional first line of the parse range.

params.name: to
params.description: Optional final line of the parse range.

params.name: cache
params.description: Set false to avoid caching sorted parser output.

exCommands.name: Markview
exCommands.label: Markview Command
exCommands.shortDescription: Control Markview previews, attachment, hybrid mode, splitview, and tracing.
exCommands.description: Run one of Markview's registered subcommands, optionally targeting a buffer where supported.

allowedValueDescriptions.Toggle: Toggle previews for all attached buffers.
allowedValueDescriptions.Enable: Enable previews for all attached buffers.
allowedValueDescriptions.Disable: Disable previews for all attached buffers.
allowedValueDescriptions.Start: Allow automatic attachment to new buffers.
allowedValueDescriptions.Stop: Prevent automatic attachment to new buffers.
allowedValueDescriptions.Clear: Clear previews for all attached buffers.
allowedValueDescriptions.Render: Render previews for all enabled attached buffers.
allowedValueDescriptions.hybridEnable: Enable hybrid mode for a buffer.
allowedValueDescriptions.hybridDisable: Disable hybrid mode for a buffer.
allowedValueDescriptions.hybridToggle: Toggle hybrid mode for a buffer.
allowedValueDescriptions.HybridEnable: Enable hybrid mode for all attached buffers.
allowedValueDescriptions.HybridDisable: Disable hybrid mode for all attached buffers.
allowedValueDescriptions.HybridToggle: Toggle hybrid mode for all attached buffers.
allowedValueDescriptions.open: Open the link under the cursor.

params.name: buffer
params.label: Buffer
params.description: Optional buffer number for buffer-scoped subcommands; those commands default to the current buffer.

exCommandTemplates.label: Toggle Current Preview
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Toggle preview in the current buffer.

exCommandTemplates.label: Toggle All Previews
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Toggle previews for all attached buffers.

exCommandTemplates.label: Toggle Splitview
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Open or close Markview's synchronized split preview.

exCommandTemplates.label: Toggle Current Hybrid Mode
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Toggle hybrid mode in the current buffer.

exCommandTemplates.label: Render Current Preview
exCommandTemplates.shortDescription: Manually redraw the current buffer's preview.
